title: UDP
description: An external system sends datagrams to Sentinel on a port you choose. Each datagram is one message (JSON, NMEA and SBS may put one message per line). Default format: sentinel.v1.Observation.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: For the sentinel format: binary protobuf (one message per datagram) or JSON (one message per line)

decoderOptions.title: Decoder options
decoderOptions.description: The decoder's options. json: a field map, with at least fields.latitude and fields.longitude; empty uses the default map (see docs/feeds.md). nmea-gps: sourceEntityId, the platform the receiver reports (required), and optionally name and entityType. cot: skipSite, a site id whose own events are dropped.

defaultSource.title: Default source
defaultSource.description: Source for sentinel messages that leave it unset

allow.title: Allowed senders
allow.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to send; empty allows anyone who can reach the port. UDP source addresses can be forged.
